content_of_post_to_comment: "Your brain will never believe you're capable of hard things until you repeatedly do hard things and survive the outcome. That's how confidence is built."
comment: There's a difference between surviving something hard and realizing you can handle it even when the outcome isn't great. I think confidence grows when you learn that failure, embarrassment, or having to start over aren't things you need to avoid at all costs. You don't have to win every time to trust yourself.
